description: The DuckDB releases Spice's tests load as an installed library. The tests that use DuckDB as an oracle need 1.5.0 or later; each entry is the newest patch release of a supported line. Keep the list in ascending order: the last entry is the release the tests use by default. Each entry records the SHA-256 of its shared-library archive per platform, which scripts/libduckdb.py checks before installing it for the tests and CI.
